description: This file defines the interface IController for plugin control within the WPEFramework. It declares a set of pure virtual functions for managing system state and configuration related to controllers, including persist, delete, reboot, environment, configuration, and clone operations.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for device controller management with methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment info, configuration, and cloning capabilities.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a resource specified by a path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieve environment details given an index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieve or set the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clone a controller from a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
